summary: M.S. Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. Built production ML systems end-to-end using Python, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. Optimized inference 5.2× through quantization; resolved real-world integration challenges and delivered 100% reliability on complex problems.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Led 7-person team as sole ML expert; built medical imaging pipeline (BraTS 2020) with U-Net, VGG, ResNet in Python; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for production deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (MS Capstone)
bullets: Architected metal surface inspection pipeline: custom wavelet denoising, monocular depth estimation; optimized PSNR from 65 to 86 through algorithms and concurrency.
Demonstrated complex problem decomposition on industrial data, from specification to production metrics (±8% 3D reconstruction error).

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT transformer on medical billing dataset using PyTorch and Hugging Face; improved validation accuracy 55% → 93% via preprocessing and model optimization.

experience.title: MS Capstone: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm
bullets: Built end-to-end ML system: STT, intent classification, TensorRT-optimized inference; achieved 5.2× speedup (56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS).
Resolved 11 integration failures; delivered 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at 11.5s latency—production-grade problem-solving under real constraints.

projects.name: SLM Compression for Edge
bullets: Reduced GPU memory 55% via 8-bit quantization (TinyLlama 1.1B); <1% accuracy loss with +0.09 perplexity on HellaSwag, GSM8K, ARC benchmarks.

projects.name: Custom Whisper-Style ASR
bullets: Built end-to-end speech recognition: 80-channel mel spectrograms, 4-block transformer, custom Cython-accelerated BPE (4–5.5× speedup); 15% WER on Hindi-English.
